channel.title: Kiki Updates
channel.description: Developer ID signed and notarized updates for Kiki.

item.description:
# Kiki 0.6.53
- Keeps direct actions visible on completed readiness checks: open permission settings, manage local models, and repeat shortcut or dictation tests. - Places actions next to each check and explains where to choose or download a local model.

# Kiki 0.6.52
- Centers the setup step numbers inside their circular badges. - Corrects the Home screen meeting description to match transcript editing and export.

# Kiki 0.6.51
- Adds a real Home orientation screen with setup status, a three-step first-dictation guide, and equal-size actions for dictation, meetings, and audio import. - Replaces the listening orb approximation with a native Metal port of OrbKit SHDR-21 Nimbus, using Templeton colors and distinct idle, thinking, and speaking motion states. - Removes Voice Studio and local voice-cloning code, menus, assets, and MLX dependencies from the application. - Preserves transcripts, dictionary entries, approved replacements, settings, and other existing local user data.

# Kiki 0.6.50
- Reduces the main interface to Transcripts, Voice Studio, Words & Replacements, and Settings. - Groups recent transcripts, recording, and audio import together; moves models into Settings. - Replaces passive correction monitoring and the Learning inbox with explicit replacements, preserving existing dictionary entries and approved rules. - Removes Home, the dedicated Dictation page, Pawprints, background confidence comparisons, and heuristic meeting briefs. - Replaces typed private-app identifiers with a native app chooser and shortens the menu bar menu. - Preserves saved user files, dictation recovery, private sessions, local transcription, and Voice Studio.

# Kiki 0.6.46
- Strengthens both Voice Halo rings with clearer resting contrast, brighter active states, and a separation keyline that remains visible over other apps. - Makes Signal Meter substantially more responsive to conversational and loud speech. - Drives each meter bar from recent microphone input so the display changes shape with the voice instead of scaling one fixed silhouette. - Preserves a calm fixed-height presentation when Reduce Motion is enabled.
